meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 signal-cli 把本机作为副设备链接到你手机上的 Signal 账号，助手用该手机号收发消息——不需要新号码，也不用 bot API。
howto.when: 当你想给助手接入 Signal 渠道、或让 Claude 执行 add-signal 时接管；链接这一步需要在你手机的 Signal 里扫一次二维码。

say.text: 用 add-signal 给我的助手接入 Signal
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并显示配对二维码

say.text: 重新生成 Signal 设备链接二维码
say.note: 旧链接约 3 分钟后过期

say.text: 给这个 Signal 用户开通访问权限
say.note: 未授权用户会被 not_member 丢弃

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude links this device as a secondary device to the Signal account on your phone via signal-cli, so the assistant sends and receives as that phone number — no new number, no bot API.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Signal channel or run add-signal; linking then needs a QR scan from the Signal app on your phone.

say_en.text: Add Signal to my assistant with add-signal
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and shows a QR to scan

say_en.text: Regenerate the Signal device-link QR code
say_en.note: The old link expires in ~3 minutes

say_en.text: Grant access to this Signal user
say_en.note: Ungranted users are dropped as not_member
